svg.text: One stride: the pose as a function of phase (writePose:phase:swing:eating:time:, bobAt:swing:)
phase grows by 2π per stride walked (rabbit 0.5 cells, fox 0.8 cells), so standing still freezes the curve and running moves along it faster.
rabbit #hop, swing 0.9: A = -s, B = 1.3 s, bob = 3 · max(sin, 0) · swing
fox #trot, swing 0.6: A = s, B = -s, bob = 0.5 · |sin 2φ| · swing
The tail also wags on the clock, 0.2 sin(2.5 s), whether or not the fox moves (not plotted).
s = sin(phase) · swing. Front and hind legs swing against each other; the body lifts in the stretched half.
